late_ineligibility_rationale: Late corrected-SAM3 overlays visibly cease to track stable part semantics from frame 1200 (rear-body label stays on the table piece while the body is attached); masks remain comparison evidence only. Retained from the v4 human/agent review.

fallback_intervals.rationale: battle-segmentation-disagreement episode chassis [1055,1172): corrected SAM3 loses the chassis (<600 px over ~1110-1166, label jumps to the yellow body 1074-1088) while DAM4SAM keeps a ~6-11k px chassis mask on the black plate; the agent-selected SAM3 correction restores the label at 1172.

not_contact_eligible_intervals.rationale: Interior label starts leaking onto the chassis plate (interior area doubles over 1020-1044) so the chassis mask is undersized; DAM4SAM's chassis is equally undersized here (IoU >= 0.54 with SAM3, both streams shrinking), so no credible substitute exists and the earlier v4 onset decision is kept.

hidden_intervals.rationale: Agent visibility label: the grey interior block protrudes below the chassis plate only until ~1022 (the surface the human accepted at frame 900); from ~1024 the region under the tracked interior mask is the chassis's own lower body and the block is hidden by the rotation until a lighter inner surface becomes boxable at 1172 (agent-selected SAM3 correction). Re-verified on zoomed source crops 1016-1034 (every frame 1020-1028) before adoption; the 1022-1024 onset is ambiguous by about two frames. DAM4SAM's interior stream is not a substitute: it merged onto the chassis body over [707,1072) and never separates the block.

claim_boundaries: The ensemble is a review reference assembled from retained runs; cross-method fallback is not accuracy and neither source run is ground truth.
Masks are copied whole from exactly one source per frame and target; no mask is blended, morphed or interpolated.

Fallback substitution happens only inside explicit agent-authored frame intervals, only when a policy rule fires, and only when the substitute passes the sanity bounds; every substitution and every declined attempt is recorded with a rationale.
Hidden intervals are agent-authored visibility labels (explicit empty masks) pending human confirmation; they are not tracker output.

Contact eligibility is per target: a mask is eligible only where it is sourced from SAM3 or DAM4SAM, passes sanity, lies before the late-degradation boundary, and is not inside an agent-labelled ineligible interval.
